name: Campingplatz Aichalehof
beschreibung: Campingplatz Aichalehof is situated on the western shore of Lake Staffelsee, offering guests direct access to the water. Uffing is a charming village in the Alpine foothills, located approximately 20 kilometres northeast of Garmisch-Partenkirchen. The campsite features generous pitches, clean sanitary buildings, and a dedicated lakeside beach access. Lovely hiking trails run nearby, and convenient railway connections make day trips across the region effortless. The rural surroundings with lush meadows and quiet woods provide wonderful peace and relaxation.
